purpose: 三套人物三视图，供用户挑选；后续再进行 Tripo 生成与骨骼绑定。

prompts.title: A · 自然运动员
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original character design turnaround sheet for a personal iOS strength-training app, Repcendo. This is concept selection for a future image-to-3D workflow and skeletal animation.
Composition: wide landscape sheet with exactly THREE full-body orthographic views of the SAME single adult character: FRONT, exact RIGHT SIDE profile facing right, BACK, arranged left to right, same scale, same ground baseline, matching anatomical landmarks and identical clothing in all views. No perspective or 3/4 views. All three figures must be visible from crown to toes with comfortable margins and enough separation.
Pose: neutral relaxed A-pose, arms straight about 30 degrees away from torso, elbows almost straight, palms oriented consistently, hands visible with five natural fingers slightly separated. Feet hip-width apart and flat. No action pose. The front and back A-pose must match. Side view must show the same pose from exactly 90 degrees. Anatomically plausible shoulder, chest, back, pelvis, glute and quadriceps shapes; natural continuous human surfaces and supple transitions at joints.
Lighting: soft neutral studio lighting, subtle contact shadow only, solid warm off-white background. Clean contours for later segmentation. Original design, not based on an existing character or celebrity. No props, gym equipment, platform, scene, tattoos, logos, dimensions, arrows, extra detail insets or costume accessories. Text only as specified, outside the figures.
Output: a polished high-resolution modeling-reference concept sheet, not a technical anatomy diagram. Muscle emphasis must come from modeled form; do not color individual muscle groups orange at this concept-selection stage.
Subject and style: attractive adult male fitness athlete around age 28, natural believable 7.5-head-tall proportions, athletic but attainable physique, medium shoulder width, well-defined but not bodybuilding chest and back, strong thighs and glutes, balanced limbs, subtle skin detail. Handsome calm adult face with defined but gentle features, short close-cropped dark hair, clean shaven. Light-medium warm skin tone. Render as a high-quality contemporary realistic 3D game character with restrained stylization, elegant anatomy, not a photograph. Bare chest, plain fitted charcoal training shorts ending at upper thigh with a tiny muted burnt-orange waistband accent, bare feet. Smooth clean shorts with very few folds, no drawstrings. The aim is a credible human exercise demonstrator whose muscle landmarks are readable in small mobile animation.
Text verbatim: small top-left title "A / ATHLETIC REALISM"; small view labels below the figures "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK".
